title: APPEAL OF DANIEL WHITTINGTON CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT’S
text:
[EXECUTIVE SESSION]
APPEAL OF DANIEL WHITTINGTON CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT’S
  SEPTEMBER 10, 2026, DECISION TO CANCEL HIS PUBLIC
  TRANSPORTATION VEHICLE (PTV) DRIVER PERMIT APPLICATION,
  PURSUANT TO BOARD ORDER 600, RULE D(1) - PERMANENT
  DISQUALIFICATION
summary: Executive-session appeal by a driver permit applicant of the department's September 10, 2026 decision to cancel a public transportation vehicle driver permit application under the permanent disqualification rule in Board Order 600.
